stem: A secondary container has liquid in it but no readable identity label. What should the technician do?
choices: Smell it to identify the contents
Use it if the color looks familiar
Do not use it until identity and labeling are resolved through the approved process
Pour it into the nearest drain
rationale: An unidentified chemical should not be used or disposed of by guesswork. Identity and labeling must be resolved through the workplace hazard-communication process.
